meta.name: deck-dir-key-nav
meta.description: 8 页单色背景, 160px display + 4px accent + Mono 箭头列表

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速创建简洁的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速制作风格统一的演示文稿
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create a clean, consistent presentation deck

howto.what: 这会生成一款极简方向键 Keynote 模板：每页单色背景，160px 大标题加 4px 粗线，配箭头前缀的等宽列表；左下角有左右方向键提示，右下角标页码。页数按内容定，至少 8 页。
howto.when: 当你需要做「有话要说但没什么可看」的极简演示，比如短文或要点分享时触发。

say.text: 用极简方向键模板做一个 8 页的月度总结
say.note: 会按该排版生成一版 Keynote。

say.text: 把这个内容改成单色背景、箭头列表的演示
say.note: 会套用模板的视觉风格重排。

say.text: 给我做一页带左右键提示和页码的封面
say.note: 会从调色板里取色并布局。

howto.what_en: This generates a minimal dir-key Keynote template: each slide has a solid color background, a 160px display title, a 4px accent bar, a mono arrow-prefixed list, with left/right kbd hints at bottom-left and page numbers at bottom-right. Slide count depends on your content, starting at 8.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need a minimal deck that's more about talking than visuals, e.g. short essays or bullet-point sharing.

say_en.text: Make an 8-page monthly summary with the minimal dir-key template.
say_en.note: It will generate the deck in that style.

say_en.text: Turn this content into a solid-color, arrow-list presentation.
say_en.note: It will restyle everything with the template.

say_en.text: Create a cover with left/right key hints and a page number.
say_en.note: It will pick a color and lay it out.
